2. unpartnered_mother_child_units: Chapter 200 explicitly collects family nucleus identification numbers (Q203-A) and relationship within the nucleus (Q203-B). Combined with sex (Q207) and marital status (Q209), unpartnered mother–child family nuclei can be identified within larger households.
3. women_maintained_by_provider: Employment and transfer income (Q524, Q530, Q556, Q557) are collected at the individual level for all household members aged 14 and older. By aggregating and comparing individual income contributions across members, researchers can identify whether a woman is the primary economic provider of the household or unit, regardless of who is declared household head in Q203.
4. mother_child_unit_activity: Household expenditure (Q105, Q117) is recorded at the aggregate household level, while personal income and work activities are recorded at the individual level. There are no variables linking consumption, production, or care activities specifically to a mother–child family nucleus ('hearth-hold') sub-unit.
